findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Aaron Siepierski" above "bonjour."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The h1 is 30px ("Good things are in the air.").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 7 different lines (59px, 34px, 46px, 74px, 394px, 480px, 585px); the three most used hold only 50% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: 4 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "Photography:" (14px); "Pause motion" (14px); "Interior photography:" (14px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.
